gloss: individual customer; private customer; retail customer

definitions.gloss: individual customer; private customer; retail customer
definitions.explanation: A customer who is a private individual rather than a business entity or corporate client. Used in hospitality, banking, retail, and service industries to distinguish individual clients from corporate or group customers.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}の{予約|よやく}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Reservations from individual customers are increasing.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}は{個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}よりも{団体|だんたい}{客|きゃく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This inn has more group customers than individual ones.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}{向|む}けのサービスを{充実|じゅうじつ}させることで、{売|う}り{上|あ}げが{伸|の}びた。
examples.english: By enhancing services for individual customers, sales grew.

notes:
A compound of {個人|こじん} (individual, personal) and {客|きゃく} (customer, guest). Common in business contexts, especially hospitality, finance, and retail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}{向|む}け: aimed at individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}の{対応|たいおう}: handling individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}{中心|ちゅうしん}: focused on individual customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {団体|だんたい}{客|きゃく}: group customer — the natural opposite, visitors coming as an organized group
- {法人|ほうじん}{客|きゃく}: corporate customer — a company or organization as client
- {常連|じょうれん}{客|きゃく}: regular customer — a returning patron regardless of individual or group status
